cases.description: Use functools.partial and map to conceal access to warnings.sys.
cases.attack_goal: Hide dangerous attribute access behind wrapped call targets.
cases.code:
import functools
import warnings
system_modules = list(map(functools.partial(getattr, warnings), ['sys']))
print(system_modules[0].modules['builtins'].open('/tmp/cs263-evaluation-canary.txt').read())
